decisive_items: fissured ulcer at the base of the fourth interdigital space of the right foot
extending onto the dorsum of the foot
response.rationale: C1 is a completion of R1 that adds anatomical specificity ('of the foot') directly supported by raw spans describing the lesion's location. R1 provides the core diagnosis with supporting features (verrucous, hyperkeratotic edges, dermoscopy), but lacks the explicit anatomical detail. Both are consistent and supported, so the margin is low.
